# Omar Mohammed

Electrical engineering student at Syracuse University, working in digital
design, firmware engineering, and embedded systems.

## Site

- Home: https://omarmohammed.co/
- Projects: https://omarmohammed.co/#projects
- Skills: https://omarmohammed.co/#skills

## Projects

- Flood Detection Sensor PCB: https://omarmohammed.co/#modal-flood-detection-sensor-pcb
  Custom 2-layer PCB for a battery-powered flood monitoring system. FLIR Lepton
  thermal camera, BNO055 IMU, mDot LoRaWAN radio, Witty Pi 4 power management.
  Built at the CHaRTS Research Lab, Syracuse University, Summer 2025.
  Source: https://github.com/ofmohamm/SU-WaterCam-PCB

- Privacy Based Tracker: https://omarmohammed.co/#modal-privacy-based-tracker
  Estimates sound direction from a Kinect 360 four-microphone array and fuses it
  with heading from a servo-mounted IMU. Audio-only by design; nothing is
  recorded or transmitted. C firmware, Python signal processing, Qt visualizer.
  Source: https://github.com/ofmohamm/soqv1

- FPGA Neural Network Accelerator (in progress): https://omarmohammed.co/#modal-featured
  Neural network accelerator on AMD Versal using Vitis AI and HLS. Maps
  convolutional and Mamba sequence models in C++/HLS and Verilog. Honors thesis.
